[center][size=4][b]What Is Beach Episode?[/b][/size][/center]

Beach Episode is a standalone SMAPI expansion focused on Ginger Island and the valley's beaches. It adds island activities, five implemented authored Scene Events, one complete album story with sequential missions, the [b]Night of the Parrots[/b], and a two-on-two [b]Beach Volleyball Championship[/b].

The mod is designed as a playful Stardew version of the classic anime beach filler episode: cozy, funny, character-driven, and separate from the main plot while still respecting your save progress.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]✨ What's Included - Initial Release 0.1[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Beach Episode Album:[/b] collect eight implemented memories — three from island activities or matching story missions, four from authored Scene Events, and one from attending the Night of the Parrots — then unlock Episode Credits. more content soon.[/*]
[*][b]One complete album story:[/b] discover The Mystery of the Missing Towel through its opening scene, accept the case, complete three ordered investigation scenes, and watch or replay its finale from the Stories tab.[/*]
[*][b]Standalone album access:[/b] press [font=Courier New]F8[/font] after loading a save; the responsive menu supports mouse, keyboard, and controller.[/*]
[*][b]Beach Volleyball Championship:[/b] on Summer 9, hear a competitor's festival line and talk again to invite them as your partner, then play two semifinals and a final. A 22-NPC cast watches the decorated 12x6 court, an original base track shifts to its banjo arrangement during matches, Gus serves the vanilla resort bar, and a Rainbow Shell trophy awaits at the champion/runner-up podium.[/*]
[*][b]Five implemented original Scene Events:[/b] four collectible character vignettes across IslandSouth, IslandEast, IslandWest, and IslandNorth, plus the opening of the complete story case.[/*]

[center][size=4][b]📸 Beach Episode Album[/b][/size][/center]

[list]

[/list]

[size=3][b]The Mystery of the Missing Towel[/b][/size]

The Stories tab includes one complete case:

[list]
[*][b]Discover it:[/b] after 45 days played, repair the boat, unlock the resort, reach 1 heart with Haley, Emily, and Leo, then enter IslandSouth on a sunny day from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Base chance: 90%.[/*]
[*][b]Accept it:[/b] open the Stories tab after the opening scene and choose [b]Accept the case[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Investigate:[/b] follow three mission cards through IslandSouth and IslandEast.[/*]
[*][b]Finish it:[/b] complete all three clues and watch the finale. It can be replayed afterward.[/*]
[/list][center][/center]

[center][size=4][b]🎬 Original Scene Events[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*][b]Dockside Cold Open[/b] — IslandSouth · Willy and Haley[/*]
[*][b]Parrot Dub Club[/b] — IslandEast · Leo, Sam, and Abigail[/*]
[*][b]Message in the Margins[/b] — IslandWest · Leo and Elliott · unlocks Chronicle in the Margins[/*]

Scene Events respect progress, friendship, location, weather, time, and daily chance. By default, the host plans at most one per day. Use [font=Courier New]SceneFrequencyPercent[/font] and [font=Courier New]MaxScenesPerDay[/font] to adjust this.

[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🏐 Beach Volleyball Championship[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Summer 9 · 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM · Ginger Island resort beach[/b]

The championship is available even before the resort is restored.

[list]
[*]Choose Alex, Sam, Haley, Abigail, Emily, Sebastian, Leah, or Elliott inside the festival. Hear their festival line, then talk to them again to invite them.[/*]
[*]Alex, Sam, and an eligible spouse accept without a friendship requirement; other candidates require 2 hearts.[/*]
[*]Play a 2v2 semifinal and final in a four-team knockout bracket.[/*]
[*]A decorated court, 22-NPC cast, two original tracks, and a Rainbow Shell trophy complete the event.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, the host selects the partner and controls the matches.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]🦜 Night of the Parrots[/b][/size][/center]

[b]Summer 22 · 6:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Boat repaired and Island Resort unlocked[/b]

The date and time are configurable. An invitation arrives the day before the festival, with a same-day mailbox fallback when loading directly on the festival date. Enter through the night ferry at the Beach or the lantern prompt on Ginger Island.

[list]
[*]Leo, Birdie, Willy, Abigail, Sam, Sebastian, Haley, Emily, Leah, Elliott, and Gus attend with unique dialogue.[/*]
[*]Sophia, Andy, Victor, and Olivia join when Stardew Valley Expanded is installed, with English, Brazilian Portuguese, and Spanish dialogue.[/*]
[*]The festival includes a food stall, the third original track, lanterns, parrots, fireflies, water reflections, and a synchronized finale.[/*]
[*]Calendar markers and reminders show when the festival is available or which requirement is missing.[/*]
[*]Date, map, or asset conflicts disable only the affected festival and are explained in the SMAPI log.[/*]
[/list]
[size=3][b]Parrot Chorus[/b][/size]

A 16-second, four-lane rhythm minigame played with [font=Courier New]D / F / J / K[/font], arrow keys, controller, or mouse.

[list]
[*][b]Relaxed Timing[/b] widens the hit windows.[/*]
[*]You can skip or disable the minigame without penalty.[/*]
[*]The score changes dialogue only; it gives no items, money, friendship, or required progress.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, each farmer plays locally and the scores are combined.[/*]
[/list]
[center]─────────────────────────────────────────────[/center]

[center][size=4][b]👥 Multiplayer and Split-Screen[/b][/size][/center]

[list]
[*]Single-player, remote multiplayer, and local split-screen are supported.[/*]
[*]Album progress is stored per farmer; the host coordinates scenes and festival state.[/*]
[*]Every connected player must have Beach Episode installed for the festivals.[/*]
[*]Extra SVE guests appear only when every connected player has SVE and a Beach Episode version that supports them.[/*]
[/list]

[center][size=4][b]📦 Installation[/b][/size][/center]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract [font=Courier New]Beach Episode[/font] into your Stardew Valley [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder.[/*]

[center][size=4][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/size][/center]

Generic Mod Config Menu is optional. You can also edit [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] manually; the mod works with defaults when the file is absent.

[spoiler]
[list]
[*][b]General:[/b] enable the mod, change the [font=Courier New]F8[/font] album key, or enable verbose logging.[/*]
[*][b]Scenes:[/b] enable scenes, change their frequency, and set the daily cap.[/*]
[*][b]Activities and volleyball:[/b] change the [font=Courier New]B[/font] key, activity limits, cooldowns, or festival availability.[/*]
[*][b]Test hub:[/b] [font=Courier New]EnableVolleyballTestLauncher[/font] temporarily replaces the normal [font=Courier New]B[/font] menu. Default: false.[/*]
[*][b]Night of the Parrots:[/b] change its season, date, hours, reminders, and repeated entry prompt.[/*]
[*][b]Accessibility and audio:[/b] relaxed rhythm timing, reduced flashes, visual effects, music, and separate volume controls.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
